fields.name: command
fields.description: specifies the type of rip message, either request or response.

fields.name: version
fields.description: the protocol version, which must be 1 for ripng.

fields.name: update check
fields.description: flag indicating whether an update is included in this message.

fields.name: auth type
fields.description: authentication type, if any, for the update included in this message.

fields.name: auth data length
fields.presence condition: if update check == true and auth type != no authentication
fields.description: length, in octets, of the authentication data.

fields.name: routing header length
fields.description: the length of the routing header, in octets.

fields.name: update list length
fields.description: the number of entries in the update list.
